```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans believe economic self-sufficiency is the ultimate answer to the challenges in Indian country.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans believe tribal communities, not Washington bureaucracies, are better situated to craft local solutions.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support reconsideration of federal and state regulations that thwart job creation so that tribal governments acting on Native Americans' behalf are not disadvantaged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans state the Democratic Party's repeated undermining of tribal sovereignty to advantage union bosses is especially egregious.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans reject a one-size-fits-all approach to federal-state-tribal partnerships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will work to expand local autonomy where tribal governments seek it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will help expand opportunity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will deliver top-flight education to future generations.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will modernize and improve the Indian Health Service to make it more responsive to local needs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will build essential infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Native Americans must be empowered to develop the rich natural resources on their lands without undue federal interference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Crime in Indian country, especially against women, is a special problem demanding immediate attention.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Inadequate resources and neglect have made Native Americans less safe and allowed safe havens to develop in Indian country for criminal narcotics enterprises.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The government must increase funding for tribal officers and investigators, FBI agents, prosecutors, and tribal jails.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The legal system must provide stability and protect property rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Everyone's civil rights must be safeguarded, including the right to due process and freedom of the press, with accountability for all government officials.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
